claims.text: The guesthouse hosted Jacqueline Onassis and Josip Broz Tito.

findings.quote: the hotel had played host to Jacqueline Onassis and Josip Broz Tito, former president of Yugoslavia

claims.text: The architect Kerry Hill restored the property, and it reopened as Amansara in 2002.

findings.quote: After a major restoration by the late architect Kerry Hill, who was responsible for a number of iconic Aman properties, the property reopened as Amansara in 2002.

claims.text: Hill played up the modernist look with cream walls, green lawns and long corridors.

findings.quote: Hill kept things simple, playing up its modernist look with stark cream walls, expansive green lawns, and long corridors.

claims.text: Suites have timber finishes and terrazzo flooring, with sliding doors and large windows for open-plan living.

findings.quote: earthy and muted tones abound with timber finishes and terrazzo flooring. Sliding doors and large windows allow open-plan living.

claims.text: The hotel is at the doorstep of the Angkor Complex, which includes the UNESCO World Heritage Site Angkor Wat.

findings.quote: It is also at the doorstep of the Angkor Complex, home to hundreds of monuments built in the 12th century. These include the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site, Angkor Wat.

claims.text: The Royal Garden is within walking distance.

findings.quote: Other heritage sites like the Royal Garden are within walking distance.

claims.text: The Kampot Pepper set offers a sampler of Khmer dishes showcasing Cambodian Kampot pepper.

findings.quote: Order the Kampot Pepper set for a sampler of Khmer delights showcasing the Cambodian spice from the coastal city in the south.

claims.text: Guests can choose international or local dishes, or both.

findings.quote: Guests can opt between international or local, or have both.

claims.text: The spa building is tucked away from the main courtyard buildings that house the suites.

findings.quote: The spa building is quietly tucked away from the main courtyard buildings that house the suites.

claims.text: The spa offers traditional Khmer treatments and a signature Aman massage.

findings.quote: Choose a traditional Khmer treatment to recalibrate your energy and stress levels, or have a signature Aman massage

claims.text: Amansara was first a guesthouse for the guests of King Norodom Sihanouk, known then as Villa Princiére.

findings.quote: Known as Villa Princiére when it first opened as a guesthouse for King Norodom Sihanouk’s guests

claims.text: Pool suites have a plunge pool in addition to a courtyard.

findings.quote: Pool suites feature a plunge pool in addition to a courtyard.

claims.text: Guests arrive on one of two black 1960s Mercedes-Benz limousines after fast-track immigration arranged by the hotel.
